metadata.title: Contour Bench / Complete Assembly
metadata.subtitle: Case 02 / stock-aware straight-strip overlap
metadata.inventory_basis: Independent full Case2 scenario; same frozen seller piece-slot inventory, no prototype or Case1 deductions and no cumulative builds.

geometry.coordinate_system: Working millimetres; X across bench, Y global layer position, Z up
geometry.dimension_label: Working scale: 100 mm/source unit; not physically measured

adaptations: Rounded source components replaced by straight rectangular prisms.
Source XZ centres and straight axes retained; small out-of-plane twists flattened.
Alternating layers use half the original repeat pitch as display thickness, giving direct face contact.
Each of all 716 real members adapted individually using established lower-outer / upper-seat-back edge anchors and global layer_index*T coordinates.
Where recorded, colliding B07 end-station strips receive bounded additional normal translations; full global contacts are rechecked and every movement is retained in validation.
source.stock_section_confirmation_scope: Recorded stock-section candidate only; not measured or physically reserved.

parts.fabrication_note: One continuous rectangular stock segment; crosscuts only. No section machining or contour cutting.

allocation.inventory_basis: Independent full Case2 scenario; same frozen seller piece-slot inventory, no prototype or Case1 deductions and no cumulative builds.
allocation.note: 716 / 716 full-bench strips allocated. OPTIMAL refers to the recorded bounded cutting-pattern menu; no mechanical or structural approval.
assumptions: Independent full Case 2 scenario against SCREEN_e0c6229ee20dfd62: 1106 recorded nominal piece slots, not Case 1 or prototype leftovers.
Direct stock-section reuse: 38.1 × 88.9 mm. 279 compatible recorded slots; 120 selected across 6 seller listings. No aggregate bundle is treated as one continuous board.
Existing seller claims and estimated potential roles remain active. Existing preliminary WALL_CLADDING eligibility is mapped to furniture geometric candidates; no strength grade inferred.
Selected source-matching defect scenarios: none. The 115198 / 115200 / 78646 examples do not match the selected sources; no defect-free claim is made.
User-approved full-bench computational profile: minimum finished length 125 mm, with actual minimum 127.666774 mm; not verified workshop safety guidance. Prototype minimum remains 200 mm.
Crosscuts enabled, 3 mm kerf per recorded cut, maximum 6 pieces per source bar, one continuous unspliced retained segment per required strip.

Original Cubbyhouse objective and constraints retained. The scoped cut-menu adapter uses two recorded balanced partitions, 2880 bounded patterns; no global unrestricted cutting-menu optimum is claimed.
Longitudinal joining disabled by max_parts=1. No ripping, planing, composite blank, contour CNC or 2D nesting. Section/machining losses are zero in this run.
Nominal saved board lengths and quantities; physically tagged board identity and additional end trimming remain unverified.
Working conversion 100 mm per original Blender unit is an inherited design assumption, not a measured source scale.
Repeat pitch 45.5696 → 76.2 mm; final length 6057.9 mm follows the new global layer spacing. Stock width and overlap placement were adapted together.
Eleven B07 members at S001–S011 translate along their original width normal by at most 29.279 mm; all lengths, axes and source IDs retained, all 1264 contacts preserved.

summary.denominator: Selected stock only. Surplus cuts, crosscut kerf and residuals are distinct; untouched stock is separate.

allocation.stock_basis: Independent full Case2 scenario; same frozen seller piece-slot inventory, no prototype or Case1 deductions and no cumulative builds.

defect_policy.note: Saved scenarios belong to 115198,115200,78646; these four candidate families have no matching listing. Uninspected source stock is not defect-free.

approval_record.basis: User explicitly approved full716-member 38.1 x 88.9 mm direct-stock bench, 6057.9 x 1458.6 x 592.0 mm layout, and 125 mm furniture computational minimum. Confirmed by coordinating root in the active user turn.

allocation.optimum_scope: Bounded two-partition stock-cutting menu, original MILP objective and constraints.

validation.optimum_scope: Two recorded balanced partitions across actual source length groups; original MILP objective and constraints unchanged.

precheck.proof: Each stock pattern produces at most six parts; original E/Q_e limits physical source usage and J/M/Q_m requires one whole part for each of 716 members. Thus 6*slots<716 proves insufficiency independently of pattern enumeration.

accounting_totals.scope: Parent source stock once; length ledger includes all cut parts, including separately recorded surplus. Ripping loss tracked by volume.

allocation.modifications: Native Member joint menus and real mediator J/C/E/M; original optimizer objective/constraints unchanged. Bounded kerf-aware cutting extension; shared real source groups across all roles.
